scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm lint && pnpm parity:check
scripts.test:rules: node scripts/with-java21.mjs firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,storage "pnpm --dir firebase-tests test:rules"
scripts.test:api: pnpm functions:build && WHATSAPP_APP_SECRET=integration-app-secret WHATSAPP_WEBHOOK_VERIFY_TOKEN=integration-verify-token WHATSAPP_GRAPH_ACCESS_TOKEN=integration-access-token node scripts/with-java21.mjs firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore,functions "pnpm --dir firebase-tests test:api"
scripts.test:e2e:web: pnpm functions:build && node scripts/with-java21.mjs firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore,functions,storage "pnpm --filter @spherepath/web test:e2e"
